question: Who was awarded the "Udyog Ratna’ award (2023) established by the Maharashtra government?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ratan Tata**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Ratan Tata** was awarded the "**Udyog Ratna**" award in **2023 **by the Maharashtra government.
 
• The "Udyog Ratna" award is a prestigious honor established to recognize significant contributions to the i**ndustry and economy of Maharashtra**.
 
• Ratan Tata, a prominent industrialist and philanthropist, has made substantial contributions to the growth and development of various sectors in India.
 
• His leadership in **Tata Group** has led to numerous advancements in technology, industry, and social welfare.
 
• The award highlights his exceptional achievements and dedication to the industrial sector in Maharashtra.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• **Ratan Tata** is the chairman emeritus of Tata Sons, the holding company of the Tata Group, which is one of India's largest and oldest conglomerates.
 
• He has been honored with numerous awards and recognitions both nationally and internationally for his contributions to business and philanthropy.
 
• Under his leadership, Tata Group expanded globally and ventured into new industries, including software, automotive, and hospitality.
 
• Ratan Tata is known for his visionary leadership and commitment to ethical business practices.
 
• He has also been actively involved in various charitable activities through the Tata Trusts, which focus on education, healthcare, and rural development.
